toegepas.voor: Hierdie groep het jy nie self gekies soos 'n maat in die klas nie.
toegepas.na: Hierdie groep het jy nie self gekies soos jy 'n maat in die klas kies nie.
toegepas.rede_vinder: As written, 'soos 'n maat' can be read as 'you did not choose this group, just as you did not choose a classmate', the opposite of the intended contrast; two added words make the meaning clear without changing it.
toegepas.fout: 'soos 'n maat in die klas' is ambiguous: it can be read as the classmate being something you also did not choose, which blurs the intended contrast.
toegepas.rede_keurder: Spelling out 'soos jy 'n maat in die klas kies' fixes the contrast the sentence intends, adds no new fact and is still easy for a Grade 4 reader.

toegepas.voor: jy en die ander kind albei
toegepas.rede_vinder: 'die ander kind' points back to a child at home who has not been mentioned; the indefinite article introduces him correctly.
toegepas.fout: 'die ander kind' points back to a child at home who has not been introduced, right after 'die ander' meant the rest of the group in the sentence before.
toegepas.rede_keurder: The indefinite article introduces the child properly and stops the reference getting tangled with 'die ander' just before it; the people and the action stay the same.

laat_vaar_vorige.blok: Wat 'n groep vir jou kan doen
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_vinder: 'sommer' is colloquial and vague for Grade 4; 'maklik' states the contrast with 'te swaar' clearly.
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_keurder: 'sommer' is natural Afrikaans a Grade 4 reader knows, so swapping it for 'maklik' is a lateral move.

laat_vaar_vorige.blok: Wat 'n groep vir jou kan doen
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_vinder: In written standard Afrikaans an object such as a box is referred to with 'dit', not the spoken 'hom'.
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_keurder: 'hom' for a box is normal written Afrikaans, so this is a lateral move.

laat_vaar_vorige.voor: toe en hy vee die vloer
laat_vaar_vorige.na: toe, en hy vee die vloer
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_vinder: AWS: 'en' joins two clauses with their own subjects (jy, hy) and verbs.
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_keurder: Both clauses are part of what the command 'Sê' tells you to say, and a comma would split the second clause off from that command.
